title: music
body:
here i will write about songs that i like

muffin man (frank zappa, captain beefheart, the mothers)

this song starts with a 90 second monologue from zappa, honestly, it makes replay almost impossible because it is delivered in the exact frank zappa inflection that you would expect. however, when the song "starts" , oh my god. the guitar tone is from another planet. its just 3 straight minutes of candy. its almost impossible not to get capitvated by it, every time it comes on i find myself having to stop what im doing to give it my entire focus. i dont know how many songs are out there that can do that to me
